notes.title: UI,quality of life update and future games
notes.content:
It's been a while since I wrote one of these xD.
Hope everyone is doing well.

[h1]Current changes:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Updated  menu
[*]Updated  text of charachters
[*]New overlay when the monitor is on
[*]The game better loads
[*]New images during [Redacted].Hey wait! Why my game crashed, oh wait...
[*]fixed bugs (shocker)
[*]Bigger outline on the cursors
[*]Diffrent cursors for diffrent degrees when moving


[/list]

[h2]Future games[/h2]


My life has been somewhat hectic, so I didn't have much time to focus on game development, but I have experimenting with AI (Neural networks) and some different styles for a horror game.
